cli.usage:
Usage:
  mytgfs auth bot    log in with a bot token
  mytgfs auth user   log in with a phone number (code at runtime)
  mytgfs channel init --bot <username>  create private channel and grant bot admin
  mytgfs sync        rebuild local index from channel history
  mytgfs mount       mount the virtual drive
  mytgfs umount [--point Y:]  safely remove mount (all if omitted)
  mytgfs daemon start|status|stop  background daemon
  mytgfs web [--port N]  local web dashboard
  mytgfs tray [--port N]  system tray: mount, auto sync, dashboard

Environment:
  MYTGFS_API_ID  override default api_id
  MYTGFS_PHONE   phone number for user login
  MYTGFS_2FA     2FA password (optional)
  MYTGFS_LANG    force language
tray.menu.open.tip: Open the web dashboard in your browser
tray.menu.close.tip: Close the web dashboard (tray and drives keep running)
tray.menu.quit.tip: Unmount all drives and exit the program
